groups.name: Self-contained page without external assets
groups.definition: Does the page ship with no external scripts or stylesheets, using a single inline style block?

groups.name: Lean lightweight markup
groups.definition: Is the page markup lean, with few scripts, few classes, few divs and minimal inline styles and metadata?

groups.name: Minimal CSS transitions
groups.definition: Does the page define few or no CSS transitions, so interaction animation is minimal?

groups.name: Hover transitions on interactive elements
groups.definition: Does the page define CSS transitions for interactive hover states?

groups.name: Awkward mid-word wrapping in narrow cards
groups.definition: Do long words in narrow cards wrap or break mid-word, creating awkward line breaks?

groups.name: Mismatched or reused icons in chips
groups.definition: Are icons in social or link chips mismatched with their labels or reused across different chips?
